summary.description: Additive rollup fields are allowed. As of the artifact-integrity change (issue #25) the summary also carries an 'artifact_references' count and an 'artifact_verification' object; as of the BEP version-matrix change (issue #32) it also carries a 'build_tool' object stating which Bazel produced the evidence. See $defs.

build_tool_identity.description: Which build tool produced the run group's evidence, read verbatim from the BEP started event's buildToolVersion field (proto build_tool_version). Emitted in summary.build_tool; each version is also recorded as a 'build_tool_identity_v1' proof block. 'versions' is empty and 'recorded' is false when no ingested BEP declared a build tool version (unknown, never fabricated); more than one entry means the run group mixes evidence from multiple Bazel versions.

tool.description: Build tool name; 'bazel' for BEP evidence.

versions.description: Distinct build tool release strings observed in this run group's BEP started events, e.g. ['7.4.1'] or ['9.0.0'].

recorded.description: True when at least one ingested BEP declared a build tool version.

artifact_verification_metrics.description: Rollup of independent artifact-integrity verification. Emitted in summary.artifact_verification and as the 'artifact_verification' block's metrics. As of issue #81 part A the rollup also carries the remote_* counts below; they are 0 unless an optional CAS probe was injected (with no probe every remote reference lands in 'unverified_remote').

verified_count.description: Local files whose recomputed SHA-256 matched the BEP-declared digest.

present_unverified.description: Local artifacts present but whose digest was NOT cross-checked: a file whose declared digest is not a recomputable SHA-256 (non-default --digest_function or a non-64-hex digest), a symlink output whose target exists on disk (symlinks declare no digest), or inline bytes with a non-SHA-256 declared digest. Presence recorded, digest neither confirmed nor contradicted.

mismatched.description: Local files whose recomputed digest contradicted the BEP-declared digest (truth-label downgraded).

missing.description: BEP-declared local files absent on disk (presence not claimed).

unverified_remote.description: Remote-only references (bytestream:// and other CAS URIs) not verified against the CAS — the no-probe default; see bazelbuild/bazel#23250.

remote_verified.description: Remote references an injected CAS probe read and whose recomputed SHA-256 matched the BEP-declared digest (issue #81 part A). The only remote tier that keeps a collectable_v1/high claim.

remote_present.description: Remote references the CAS reports present but whose bytes were not hash-checked (probe read no digest, or the declared digest is not a recomputable SHA-256). Presence recorded, digest neither confirmed nor contradicted.

remote_mismatch.description: Remote references the CAS probe read but whose recomputed digest contradicted the BEP-declared digest (truth-label downgraded).

remote_missing.description: Remote references the CAS confirms are ABSENT — the actual bazelbuild/bazel#23250 upload-failure mode (truth-label downgraded).

artifact_reference.description: One BEP-referenced artifact with its independent verification state. Appears in the 'artifact_verification' block payload.references[].

declared_digest.description: Digest as declared by the BEP (hex of the build's configured --digest_function; SHA-256 by default).

computed_digest.description: SHA-256 recomputed by NLFR from local bytes; null when not locally readable or when the declared digest is not a recomputable SHA-256.

digest_verified.description: true when recomputed matched declared, false on mismatch, null when no local comparison was possible (missing, remote, no declared digest, or a non-SHA-256 declared digest).

presence.description: local_present marks an artifact that is present but whose digest was not cross-checked: a file with a non-recomputable-SHA-256 declared digest, a symlink output whose target exists on disk (no declared digest), or inline bytes with a non-SHA-256 declared digest. The remote_* values (issue #81 part A) come from an injected CAS probe: remote_verified (bytes read, recomputed SHA-256 matched declared), remote_present (present, not hash-checked), remote_mismatch (read, digest contradicts declared), remote_missing (CAS confirms the blob ABSENT — bazelbuild/bazel#23250). With no probe a remote reference stays unverified_remote_reference.
